Inspired by cozy teal-roof European fantasy architecture. True 2:1 dimetric game projection, parallel ground axes at slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical walls, no perspective convergence. Single fully visible house centered in a square image with generous transparent padding; genuine transparent alpha background. No ground island, no landscape, no trees, no text, no labels, no grid, no cast shadow outside footprint. Approximately a 192-pixel-wide sprite presented at integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. This variant: cozy one-and-a-half-storey square cottage, a modest porch, single centered dormer, squat stone chimney. All roof geometry must align perfectly with supporting walls and dormer faces must use the same isometric projection.
